assign.outcome:
**Eighteen realms opened cold, thirteen failed the ten-second test, all eighteen pass now.** Eighteen Sonnet reviewers, one per realm under `/imagine/`, each screenshotted its realm at 1280 and 3440, wrote down what a stranger would say the page was for and what the page's own code said it was for, drove the first thing a reader would click with `ui-test`, and then **fixed what it found instead of filing it** — the owner's actual complaint. **55 fixes landed, 14 proposals written up** for changes that belonged in `core/` or `ext/`. ~3.10M subagent tokens across the fleet; six foreground rounds of three, no round stalled.

![](review-1280.jpg)

**The three least clear, cold:** `platform` (a stranger read the landing page as an internal AI status report — tokens spent, minions dispatched, run logs — where the purpose should have been); `research` (368 claims rendered flat, 14,413px deep at 3440, now 877px behind a disclosure, a 94% cut); `generated` (one lonely card that read as a broken admin screen).

**What kept going wrong, five patterns:** (1) the first sentence written in the author's own vocabulary — 11 of 18, best shown by `shells` ("chrome", never defined) and `scenes` (one jargon paragraph composed onto six child pages at once); (2) the page described how it was built, not what you can do with it (`platform`, `team`); (3) the front door broke the rule the realm itself teaches (`design`, `blogx`); (4) an inline `doc/*.md` link ends in an extension, the router never intercepts those, so the click dumped the reader on raw unstyled markdown — 6 realms, 5 shipped the same local shim (`scenes`, `cms`); (5) what core does for a page is decided by one word the page forgets to say — a missing `index: true` gave `feeds` and `stream` a duplicate link rail, and the sharpest case is `youtube`, whose whole printed keyboard legend did nothing and whose poll timer leaked forever because a `default` column never receives `activate()`. Only driving the page found that one.

**Verified:** review page zero console errors at 1280 and 3440, no horizontal overflow, all 18 shots load, all 54 outbound links 200. A grid (`minmax(24em, 1fr)`), not a stack of rows — a row per realm ran its sentences to 2,900px at 3440, the exact defect the page reports about others. `width: "fill"`, not `"full"`: `full` collapses `/imagine/`'s hub rail, as gallery found and reverted the same day.

**Left open, deliberately:** the 14 proposals are unapplied because they change shared `core/`/`ext/` code — the largest are a route for `doc/*.md` files, an `activate()` lifecycle for `default` columns, and a card description that stops truncating to one line. Each is in its reviewer's log with the diff.

**Also fixed here:** all 18 reviewer task pages 404'd on `requirements.md` (an empty REQUIREMENTS tab); each now has a two-line one pointing at the shared brief.
